name: Dark survey
description: Night-mode survey sheet: dark ink fills with pale lines.
_note: Fills are named swatches the panel creates by script (names 'VB <Part> - <choice>') and assigns to the paths on the named layers (Roads, Buildings, Fences, Water). Scripts cannot create graphic styles or pattern swatches: keep any graphic styles in illustrator/templates/varrenmoor.ait and apply them by hand; the textures are represented by their mean colour.
